subject: Quick check on the speaker rental
text: Hi! I hope your week is going okay despite all the craziness. I wanted to follow up on the speaker rental I grabbed for the community night, since I know the venue is moving fast and we are down to the wire. The shop said they would drop off the second box before Thursday, but their message was a bit vague about the exact window. Could you peek at the setup sheet and let me know if a late afternoon delivery throws anyone off? If it does, I can beg the store to rush it or borrow some gear from my uncle’s garage. Honestly, I do not want this little logistics snag to derail the program, especially with the big sponsor visit hanging over everyone’s heads. You have been keeping the whole schedule from falling apart, so just tell me what works best. If you are swamped, no need for a long explanation, a thumbs up or “nope” is plenty. I really appreciate you, and I will bring coffee tomorrow so we can laugh at spreadsheets together. Also, if you want to swing by the hall after work, I can show you where the cables will hide, assuming they cooperate this time. Take care!
